answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a stake-weighted trellis of attestations, where peers co-sign only after cross-checking a karst of irregular challenge paths that no single actor can precompute. Honest nodes then form a stable oasis of high-cost credentials, since forging a parallel identity requires replicating the full attestation graph. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
